title: Scripture Reading-Plan Progress
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=scripture:reading
| stats dc(passage) as passages_read, max(plan_total) as plan_total
| eval progress_pct=round(100*passages_read/plan_total,1), remaining=plan_total-passages_read
description: Shows how far through a reading plan you are and how much remains to finish on schedule.
value: A clear progress bar keeps a long reading plan achievable and encourages you to catch up when behind.
implementation: Ingest reading-plan entries into `index=personal`; compute progress against the plan total.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It shows how far through your reading plan you are and how much is left, keeping you on track.
